entities.title: Letterpress Lab
entities.description: Creativity abounds in all of the McNeal Hall design labs, and here in the Letterpress Lab, the past is preserved. The lab's typefaces collection contains over 100 different historically significant styles with design influences that span from early Rome to advertising scripts of the mid-20th century.
